address: 285 Sappasit Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani, Ubon Ratchathani, 34000, Thailand
bio: This lively local restaurant specialises in fish, with daily catches such as grouper or sea bass prepared in a variety of traditional Thai styles. They can be served whole for sharing or in individual portions. The confident cooking delivers authentic Thai flavours, while meat dishes are equally rewarding: the stir-fried beef is fragrant with young galangal and Thai herbs. Finish with the toddy palm jelly in fresh coconut milk, a speciality of the province.
